---
name: prefect-worktree-test-setup
description: How to get a runnable pytest env in the rq5 Prefect scratch worktrees
metadata:
  type: project
---

The rq5 Prefect scratch worktrees ship with NO installed Python env. System `python`/`python3` is 3.6 with an old pytest and no deps; the shared `../../.venv` (Python 3.12) has no `prefect`/`sqlalchemy` either.

**How to apply:** From the worktree root run `uv sync --group dev` (dev is a `[dependency-groups]` entry, NOT an optional-extra — `uv sync --extra dev` fails). Then run tests via `uv run --group dev pytest ...`. The full suite is huge and needs subprocess servers; run a targeted module for quick health checks (e.g. `tests/utilities/test_names.py`).
